name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 12 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 12 hours starting 2026-01-25, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 4.74 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
